title: Adjunctions satisfying the projection formula
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. Let $P\dashv S$ be an adjunction, with $P\colon\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and
$S\colon\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$, unit $u$, and hom-set bijections as in [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Suppose $S$ is strong monoidal with structure maps
$\mu^S$ [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]. The *projection formula map*
$$
P(SL\otimes M)\to L\otimes PM\qquad(L\in\mathcal D,\ M\in\mathcal C)
$$
is the adjoint of
$SL\otimes M\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}_{SL}\otimes u_M}SL\otimes SPM\xrightarrow{\mu^S_{L,PM}}S(L\otimes PM)$.
Here the adjoint is the inverse image under the bijection
$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(P(SL\otimes M),L\otimes PM)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(SL\otimes M,S(L\otimes PM))$.
The adjunction *satisfies the projection formula* if all projection formula maps are
isomorphisms, that is, each has a two-sided inverse.

mathlib_searches.query: An adjunction with strong monoidal right adjoint satisfies the projection formula when the canonical maps P(S L tensor M) to L tensor P M are isomorphisms
mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.unit_app_tensor_comp_map_δ, rightAdjointLaxMonoidal_μ, map_μ_comp_counit_app_tensor and tensorRightAdjunction; these concern monoidal adjunctions or rigid categories, not the projection-formula predicate for an arbitrary adjunction with monoidal right adjoint.
Adjunction.map_η_comp_η, ε_comp_map_ε, IsMonoidal.instIsMonoidalCounit/Unit and mapMon; those assume monoidality of an adjunction and do not define the requested map or predicate.

mathlib_searches.query: The projection formula for an adjunction with a monoidal right adjoint is invertibility of its adjoint tensor comparison morphisms
